tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/src"
for i in 1 2 3 4; do echo v$i > "$t/src/a.txt"; BACKUP_STAMP=2026010$i-100000 bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo "$t/src" >/dev/null; done
echo '--- rotate --keep 2 (expect oldest two deleted):'; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep=2
echo '--- remaining:'; ls "$t/dest"
echo '--- dry-run --keep 1 (deletes nothing):'; bash rotate.sh --quiet -n --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 1; ls "$t/dest" | wc -l
echo '--- keep 0 rejected:'; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"
echo '--- bad --keep value:'; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep abc 2>&1 | tail -1; 
echo '--- unknown flag:'; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo '--- missing --name:'; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo '--- help exits 0:'; bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Manually exercise rotate.sh flags and rotation behavior

tool_input.command: v=$(mktemp -d); printf 'onlydigest\n' > "$v/broken-1.sha256"; bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$v"; echo "rc=$?"; rm -rf "$v"
tool_input.description: Check malformed sidecar is reported BAD
Check malformed sidecar is reported BAD, clean up temp scripts

result:
All 8 tests pass, and `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` are untouched.

What changed:

- **rotate.sh** — `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"` on the oldest-first sorted list, so it kept the oldest `keep-1` archives and deleted the newest (with exactly N archives, line N = the newest one). It now deletes the oldest `total - keep` entries via `head -n` (with a guard, since BSD `head` rejects `-n 0`). Also replaced its inline option-parsing/`resolve_dir` block with a source of the new lib.
- **verify.sh** — sidecar parsing used `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated names containing spaces at the first space. It now takes the digest as the first whitespace-delimited field and the file name as the rest of the line after the separator, so `my backup-….tar.gz` verifies `ok`. Malformed-sidecar handling is preserved, and the digest comparison now quotes its operands. Also sources the new lib.
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — the shared option-parsing block (`--dest/--name/--keep/--quiet/--dry-run/--help`, `--`, `parse_local_option` hook), `is_uint`, `need_value`, KEEP validation, and `resolve_dir`, with a double-sourcing guard like `lib/log.sh`. Sourced by `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` only; both accept the same flags (verified `=value` forms, missing values, unknown flags, help, positional rejection).
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — one test per bug: `rotate --keep 3` with exactly 3 archives deletes nothing (newest included), and `verify` reports `ok`/rc=0 for `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz`.

Changed files: rotate.sh, verify.sh, tests/run_tests.sh, plus new lib/common.sh.
